sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: New sustained tonal partials enter the score here; orbs are mid-orbit with no discrete visual hit, so read as a musical note rather than a chime SFX.

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: Lands as the orbs settle left/right at the end of the orbit; a short transient follows ~60 ms later but it is not clearly an SFX.

pattern.description: Two gradient orbs orbit around a common centre inside concentric outline rings, swapping positions with perspective scaling (the near orb grows, the far one shrinks) while the rings expand, settling side by side on a wider orbit.
pattern.why_premium: A slow, continuous orbit with depth-based scaling turns two voices into a dance (imitate vs embody) without any cut, and the expanding rings give spatial depth and a calm, measured rhythm under the narration.

build_hint.gsap: Put both orbs in a rotating parent: tl.to('.orbit', {rotation:540, duration:3.3, ease:'sine.inOut'}) with counter-rotation on '.orb' to keep gradients upright; drive orb scale from orbit angle (scale = 1 + 0.6*sin(angle)) via onUpdate, opposite phase per orb; tl.fromTo('.ring', {scale:0.6}, {scale:1, duration:3.3, ease:'sine.inOut', stagger:0.08}, 0); radius grows 0.6 to 1 in parallel.
build_hint.remotion: angle = interpolate(frame,[0,100],[0,3*Math.PI],{easing:Easing.inOut(Easing.sin)}); orb x = cx + r*cos(angle + phase), y = cy + r*0.6*sin(angle + phase), scale = 1 + 0.6*sin(angle + phase); ring and orbit radius r interpolated 0.6 to 1 with the same easing; no spring (continuous orbit).

notes: Camera verdict none; the scale and pan sums come from the rings expanding and orbs travelling. Energy has a single near-zero sample mid-burst (likely a duplicate frame). Exact number of orbit turns is not measurable from 7 frames.
